prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one complete original high fidelity 1536x1024 product design for the existing Chinese companion app 在场. Primary request: create a breathtaking yet calm usable route pocket inside a continuous conversation room. Pure text generation. There are no input images; do not imitate a collage of an old UI screenshot. Design the product through this living moment: the student has just asked how to walk from 蒙民伟楼 to 基础图书馆 and their companion has quietly laid a small campus map on the warm desk, while a paused focus lamp keeps their unfinished thought nearby. Spacious Apple-like restraint, natural daylight, warm ivory paper, pale mist blue geography and muted honey-gold route; no green UI. Room: one complete softly lit window alcove and pale wood table at the far right quarter; continuous physical light across the page, no gray sidebar, no hard split, no frosted boxes piled up. Keep the main left content area readable with believable depth and light, not a washed-out empty white wall. Navigation: 在场 upper left, centered 聊天 今天 留下 with 聊天 selected, small search and ellipsis upper right. The conversation content is elegant Chinese text with a quiet line above the map: “从这里走过去，先看看这条路。” The actual map is a broad integrated, gently rounded paper map in the center-left, not full page imagery. Show a plausible restrained campus plan, real map graphic language, crisp building footprints, water and path lines, an A and B marker and one slim gold route from 蒙民伟楼 to 基础图书馆. This is a design image; the final product will render its real geography rather than copying this illustrative geometry. Map top contains a compact location search, unobtrusive compass/zoom control and an expand icon. Below the map, use a generous quiet footer in two natural rows: first the route names plus “约 300 米”, next one primary paper-edge action “带这条路回对话” and a small coherent playback/fit group with icons labelled “预览” and “回到路线”; avoid six tiny text buttons squeezed side by side. Keep route details as a discreet disclosure “入口与路线来源”. Show a visible but very restrained drag grip centered at the upper map edge, implying expansion of this same map. Below the map is the one existing conversation composer, full real width, placeholder “接着说…”, small plus left and round arrow send right. Under it a tiny desk lamp icon, paused time “12:34”, “继续这段” and “结束”, as one light line of controls with no stopwatch card or productivity badge. Beside the composer paper edge a small tasteful folded bookmark reading “回到刚才那页” can be taken or ignored; do not add a panel or instruction paragraph. The right room edge has no illustrated character so the map remains the main work; the space should feel occupied by a companion through the lamp, bookmark and considered task support, without a giant figure or fake portrait. Crisp hierarchy, minimal borders, soft single object shadow, native readable typography, generous alignment. All text and controls need to be implemented as live components; do not make a photo of a monitor, do not add mockup frame. No achievements, progress rings, engineering status, chart cards, decorative dashboards, split day/night, hard dividing rails, arbitrary arrows, empty gray surfaces or excessive help text.
output: 前端视觉创新设计/补充图稿/2026-10-25-life-continuity/route-pocket-focus-v1.png

review.primaryScope: 主代理亲看并采用地图工作面、纸面与操作主次关系；不采用生成地理、事实或整页贴图。

adoptionScope: Route paper edge, legible two-row footer, single clear handoff action, coherent preview/fit group and small focus line. All geography, source facts, controls, current route and state remain real owner-rendered native components.
knownLimitations: Illustrated geography and exact distance are design examples only and must never replace actual map data.
New image invented book text and a folded resume bookmark; only existing real restore point may enter live UI.
The main map and composer are native components, never full-page raster backgrounds.
